name: translator-onlyoffice-plugin
description: ONLYOFFICE spreadsheet plugin that translates cells and shape text in place, storing translation memory inside the workbook.
author: Hitesh Baliyan

scripts.vendor-bergamot: FILE=$(npm pack @mkljczk/bergamot-translator) && rm -rf vendors/bergamot-translator && mkdir -p vendors/bergamot-translator && tar -xzf "$FILE" -C vendors/bergamot-translator --strip-components=1 && rm "$FILE"
scripts.vendor-eld: FILE=$(npm pack eld) && rm -rf vendors/eld && mkdir -p vendors/eld && tar -xzf "$FILE" -C vendors/eld --strip-components=1 && rm "$FILE"
